g.text: Four hard problems between design and production
① Latency
seconds per clip → ~30ms per frame
click and wait seconds, and it is not a game
fix: self-forcing, smaller models,
KV cache compression, edge GPUs
② Consistency
small errors accumulate and the world drifts
it has to hold for minutes, not frames
fix: pinned by the data model + longer context
(what was generated ten minutes ago conditions now)
③ Multiplayer
drawing a crowd ≠ running 20,000 states
my action must appear on everyone's screen
fix: the server decides truth, each client
generates only its view, prediction runs locally
④ Creator control
fun comes from rules, not from graphics
a generated world still obeys the creator
fix: the game cartridge harness —
wrap the model in deterministic game logic
A game demands all four at once, at the harshest settings
